data: In the second rightmost plot, what is the label of the black dot with the highest score?

The question asks about the label of the black dot with the highest score in the second rightmost plot. The second rightmost plot corresponds to the 'Frappat' function. In this plot, the black dots represent the fitting errors, and the label of the black dot with the highest score can be identified by its position on the x-axis.
